payload.body: **WP11 commit 1 is on main: 95a75e8** (parent cc78a0d). It holds src/plan.rs and src/workbook.rs (new), plus WP11's changes to Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock, src/lib.rs, src/sync.rs, tests/cli.rs, tests/golden/README.md, tests/golden/xlsx-cells and tests/pplr_sync.bats; the shared tree has no uncommitted WP11 code left, so your WP14 can rebase onto it. Commit 2 (the workbook's styling compared with the legacy's) touches only tests/golden/xlsx-cells, the two sync-plan goldens and, if the port gets something wrong, src/workbook.rs.
